cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random
random.seed(3)
# 60000 single-byte frames at distinct sparse offsets in ONE stream (max block churn), overlap first
traces=[]
sent={'I':[],'H':[],'A':[]}
events=[{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'A','action':'install'}]
offs = random.sample(range(0, 10**12), 60000)
i=0
pkts_total=0
while i < 60000:
    pkts=[]
    for j in range(16):
        frames=[{'type':'STREAM','id':0,'offset':offs[i+k],'data_hex':'ff','fin':False} for k in range(4) if i+k<60000]
        i+=4
        pkts.append({'level':'A','pn':pkts_total,'auth':True,'frames':frames})
        pkts_total+=1
    events.append({'t':len(events)*10,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':pkts})
traces.append({'id':'t','config':{'early':False,'overlap':'first','buffer_packets':64,'idle_ms':0,
   'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,'max_data':4611686018427387903,
   'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':sent},'events':events})
req=json.dumps({'version':1,'traces':traces}).encode()
print('reqMB',round(len(req)/1e6,2),'pkts',pkts_total)
open('/app/work/s_sparse.json','wb').write(req)
EOF
